note: Shareware episodes and freeware releases only. Relic ships no game data itself.

games.title: DOOM
games.description: Knee-Deep in the Dead, the free first episode of the game that defined the FPS.
games.hint: Arrows or the d-pad to move, Ctrl fires, Alt+left/right strafes, Space opens doors.

games.title: Wolfenstein 3D
games.description: Escape from Castle Wolfenstein. Episode one, the one id gave away.
games.hint: Ctrl fires, Space opens doors, 1-4 switch weapons.

games.title: Rise of the Triad
games.description: The HUNT Begins. Absurd weapons, bouncing enemies and jump pads.
games.hint: Run SETUP.EXE once if the controls feel wrong.

games.title: Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold
games.description: Wolfenstein's engine sent to a sci-fi lab complex, with talking guards and vending machines.
games.hint: Ctrl fires, Space uses switches and doors.

games.title: Commander Keen: Marooned on Mars
games.description: The side-scroller that proved a PC could do Mario. Episode one.
games.hint: Ctrl jumps, Alt uses the pogo stick.

games.title: Duke Nukem
games.description: Before the one-liners and the 3D: a fast, chunky EGA platformer.

games.title: Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure
games.description: A small alien with suction-cup hands looking for his parents. Forbidden Planet.
games.hint: Ctrl jumps, Alt for a higher bounce off enemies.

games.title: Crystal Caves
games.description: Mine crystals, dodge critters, get rich. Troubles with Twibbles.

games.title: Secret Agent
games.description: Agent 006 1/2 raids island bases. Crystal Caves' engine with a spy hat on.

games.title: Bio Menace
games.description: Snake Logan versus a city full of mutants, on the Commander Keen engine.
games.hint: Ctrl jumps, Alt fires, up+Ctrl to enter doors.

games.title: Monster Bash
games.description: Johnny Dash goes after the monster that stole every pet on the block.

games.title: Hocus Pocus
games.description: A wizard's apprentice blasting his way through four bright VGA worlds.

games.title: Paganitzu
games.description: Push blocks, dodge snakes, loot the temple. A tile puzzler with a whip-crack pace.
games.hint: Arrows only — this one's pure puzzle.

games.title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
games.description: Vertical shooter with a shop between missions. Spend the money, buy the plasma.
games.hint: Best played with the touch mouse in direct mode — your ship follows your finger.

games.title: Alien Carnage
games.description: Halloween Harry with a jetpack and a flamethrower, rescuing hostages from zombies.
games.hint: Ctrl jumps, Alt fires, hold jump for the jetpack.
